expectations.text: Defines a named persona with description
expectations.evidence: Persona is named "Reporting Analyst" with a description paragraph explaining Jordan's role, goals, and pain points related to exporting dashboard data for offline sharing.

expectations.text: Success metrics are verifiable without analytics infrastructure
expectations.evidence: Success metrics use pass/fail tester verification (e.g., "A tester can export the visible dashboard report and open the resulting CSV in a spreadsheet application") with no percentage adoption rates, performance timing thresholds, or analytics tracking requirements.
